summary_en: 17,000,000 shares (5.31% of shares outstanding ex-treasury), ¥30.0B upper limit, open-market acquisition window 2026-08-07 to 2027-03-31, method via securities company trading mandate. Policy background: one component of ¥80.0B three-year cumulative buyback (FY3/27–3/29) aligned with medium-term plan Phase 1; acquired shares to be fully cancelled post-completion.
title_en: Notice regarding determination of matters concerning acquisition of treasury shares (acquisition of treasury shares based on articles of incorporation provisions under Company Law Article 165, Paragraph 2)
translation_en_brief: Seiko Epson announced on 2026-08-05 a treasury share acquisition program resolving to acquire up to 17,000,000 shares (5.31% of shares outstanding excluding treasury as of 2026-06-30) for a maximum outlay of ¥30.0 billion. The acquisition will proceed via open-market purchase through a securities company (trading mandate method) over the window 2026-08-07 to 2027-03-31. The shares are to be fully cancelled following completion. The company states the acquisition is part of its medium-term plan Phase 1 (FY3/27–3/29 spanning fiscal 2026–2028), during which cumulative treasury acquisitions are targeted at ¥80.0 billion to support optimal capital allocation centred on ROIC improvement while maintaining financial soundness and balancing growth investment with shareholder returns.
